title: Chinese Hanfu Portrait (Jimeng)
description: Traditional Chinese hanfu portrait using Jimeng AI. Perfect for Chinese cultural content, hanfu photography, and Asian history blogs.

prompt.main: 古风汉服美女肖像，红色丝绸汉服，精致发髻配金色步摇，江南庭院背景，手持团扇，柔和自然光，工笔重彩风格，水墨晕染背景，中国传统美学
prompt.negative: 现代服饰，西方风格，卡通，3D，照片

explained.why: Jimeng (即梦) by ByteDance understands Chinese aesthetics deeply.
古风 (ancient style) preset renders traditional Chinese aesthetics.

tutorial.intro: Jimeng (即梦) is built by ByteDance specifically for Chinese aesthetics. Use Chinese phrases + named historical periods.
steps: Format: 古风汉服美女肖像 — Chinese phrase + hanfu context.
Outfit: 红色丝绸汉服 — specific color + material.
Hair: 精致发髻配金色步摇 — traditional hair + accessory.
Background: 江南庭院背景 — Jiangnan garden = traditional setting.
Prop: 手持团扇 — holding a fan = classical pose.
Style: 工笔重彩风格，水墨晕染背景 — gongbi painting style + ink wash background.
tutorial.tips: Jimeng loves Chinese cultural keywords: 工笔 (gongbi), 写意 (xieyi), 水墨 (ink wash), 江南 (Jiangnan). Use them freely.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "chinese hanfu portrait, red silk, jiangnan garden --ar 2:3 --v 6.1 --s 800".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL + Dreamshaper with Chinese LoRA. Jimeng is best for Chinese style.
crossModel.flux: Flux is OK for general Chinese aesthetic but Jimeng is best for traditional.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A traditional Chinese hanfu portrait of a woman in red silk, Jiangnan garden background, holding a fan, gongbi painting style".
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 古风汉服美女肖像，红色丝绸汉服，精致发髻配金色步摇，江南庭院背景，手持团扇，柔和自然光，工笔重彩风格，水墨晕染背景，中国传统美学。

faq.q: Why does my Chinese portrait look generic Asian?
faq.a: You forgot the specific era + named setting (Jiangnan) + traditional prop (fan). Specificity = authenticity.

faq.q: How to make it look like a painting?
faq.a: Use "工笔重彩" (gongbi) or "水墨" (ink wash). These are the two main Chinese painting styles.
Jimeng with 古风 preset + Jiangnan/silk references. Reads as "Chinese culture" instantly.
